scope: Artifact audit by the collector author; not a separately authored collection audit or a C# comparison. No source or casing replay during this audit.

collector.publicationBeforeCollection: Root reports publication before the first successful collection. Each artifact laboratory file matches the raw Git blob at the admitted commit.

runtime.executableRole: stdlib venv launcher; this digest does not attest the actual dynamically loaded interpreter DLL or all Python runtime libraries

collectionRun.provenance: Root runner confirmation, distinct from artifact field checks
collectionRun.route: Existing isolated stdlib virtual environment, no package installation for this collection; absent external output directory

helperCasing.framing: Independently for input and output append uint32 little-endian cp, then uint32 little-endian length of text.encode(UTF8,strict), then those bytes. SHA256 starts empty per plane/recipe. No BOM, separator, terminator or normalization.

audit.method: Rehash artifact and immutable Git blobs/helpers; verify AST/segment/line; reconstruct canonical central node records and input/cache snapshots; verify actual body/binder argument values and their distinct order; reconstruct only framed scalar input strings.

limits: 28 comparable records include a blocker with no body call; 27 ordinary string cases yield 32 strings after repeat-last mapping.
Eight AttributeError observations arise from null/integer values passed to the actual source body. Their local typed diagnostics and engine STRING coercion are separate contracts.
Four invalid modes return one identity string output each at the source mapper boundary; this is separate from managed COMBO admission. No exception or empty output is substituted.
The source mapper boundary does not execute upstream HTTP, frontend or global input/COMBO validation.
85 plans exhaust valid scalars within five fixed constructions, not every Unicode string/context. The historical 68 lower plans are not regenerated or counted here.

Off-run raw records and individual exhaustive output rows are not retained. Neutral central hashes and exhaustive input hashes were recomputed; output hashes were checked for recorded repeat agreement only.
No product table, extractor, C# result or accepted fixture was read to compute source outputs.
This source evidence alone does not qualify C#, other platforms, distribution binaries, cancellation/ownership, resource exhaustion or native models.
